run_train_vjepa_droid: run the main training loop for V-JEPA Droid model with distributed data parallel configuration
init_video_model: initialize a V-JEPA video model with encoder, predictor, and target encoder for self-supervised learning
init_opt: initialize optimizer, scaler, scheduler, and weight decay scheduler for mixed precision training
init_data: initialize unsupervised video data loader with distributed sampler and configurable transforms
load_checkpoint: load training checkpoint restoring encoder, predictor, target encoder, optimizer, and scheduler state
